## Overview

### Why

The Performant feature card still showed the image exported from the mock. SHA-215 rebuilds its illustration in code and gives it a story that plays on hover.

### Behavior change

The Performant card draws the mock's GPU chip in the DOM. A hover streams particles under the chip and brings its halo up to full glow. When the pointer leaves, each particle finishes its trip, and the halo settles back.

### Checks

- `features-performant.spec.ts` covers the hover, the drain back to an empty still frame, a hover during the drain, touch, a touch-screen laptop, and reduced motion.

### Not covered

The Composable and Reactive cards still show the images exported from the mock.

## Draw the card in code instead of an image

The Performant card's illustration is now a component, so the image exported from the mock goes.
